build_bccd_dataset_builder: build a BCCD dataset builder using tfds.builder_cls('bccd') for blood cell detection
create_bccd_dataset_info: create dataset info with image features and bounding box labels for RBC, WBC, and Platelets
test_bccd_splits: test the BCCD dataset builder with train, validation, and test splits from XML annotations
refactor_bccd_generate_examples: refactor the _generate_examples method to yield image and bounding box examples from XML files
review_bccd_builder: review the BCCD GeneratorBasedBuilder class that downloads and parses the blood cell dataset
